name: cable sitting bench single arm twisting row
description: A seated one-arm cable row where you rotate the torso and wrist as you pull. It works the lats and mid back through a longer range.
instructions: Sit on a bench facing a low cable with your feet braced and take the handle in one hand.
Sit tall with your arm extended and your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Pull the handle back while rotating your torso and wrist toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine at the end.
Return slowly with your arm extended and your torso rotating back.
Keep your chest up, then switch sides after your reps.
